said on Thursday that its Bitcoin
, and equivalents were worth ~$75.6M as of Sept. 24, down from $79.1M a year earlier.
The holdings included 802.77 Bitcoin equivalents worth $67.7M and 2,949.79 Ethereum equivalents worth $7.9M.
The hosting revenue rose 15.3% to $7.5M in 2025 but accounted for only 4.9% of total revenue. Commodity trading remained its largest revenue segment.
Meanwhile, the company is now exploring a 500 MW AI and cloud data center campus in Indonesia, with an initial 50 MW phase if the project moves ahead.
The proposed project remains preliminary, with no financing or binding customer agreements secured.
The company said potential tenant interest of about 180 MW is currently nonbinding.
On the market side, the SOS shares fell 2.47% to about $0.34.

title: SOS Limited stock slides as crypto holdings fall to $75.6M
